2608.14502.title: Universal Thermodynamic Interatomic Potentials for Crystalline Materials
2608.14502.paper_summary: Free energies govern solid-state phase stability, yet computational materials discovery still relies largely on ground-state energies because free energy calculations require ensemble averages. We introduce the thermodynamic interatomic potential (TIP), which extends an interatomic potential from its static energy to a thermodynamically consistent Gibbs free energy model, with thermodynamic responses following from temperature and pressure by automatic differentiation. We implement TIP[UMA] using the universal potential UMA, train it on free energies from quasi-harmonic to molecular dynamics fidelity, and calibrate it to higher-resolution calculations or experiment. From a single evaluation, it returns the equation of state of a crystal and locates phase transitions among competing branches, including dynamically stabilized phases. Fine-tuning extends the model to alloy solubility limits and miscibility gaps. TIP makes the free energy as accessible as the potential energy, opening finite-temperature phase stability to high-throughput discovery.
2608.14502.paper_summary_zh: 自由能主導固態相的穩定性，但計算材料發現仍然在很大程度上依賴於基態能量，因為自由能計算需要集合平均。我們引入熱力學原子間勢（TIP），它將靜態能量的原子間勢擴展到熱力學一致的吉布斯自由能模型，熱力學響應通過自動微分隨著溫度和壓力而變化。我們使用通用勢 UMA 實現 TIP[UMA]，並在從準諧波到分子動力學精度的自由能上進行訓練，並將其校準到更高分辨率的計算或實驗。從單次評估中，它返回晶體的狀態方程並定位競爭分支之間的相變，包括動態穩定的相。微調將模型擴展到合金溶解度極限和混溶間隙。TIP 使自由能的可獲取性與勢能相當，為高通量發現開啟了有限溫度相的穩定性。
